methodology: Curated city entities use their Wikidata geography. Population is cross-checked with GeoNames when boundaries align; climate uses NASA POWER; national context uses World Bank WDI; amenity access uses OpenStreetMap counts within 10 km, while transit compares density within 10 km and 25 km; immigration pathway scores are reviewed LandingPoint comparisons of official country portals.

populationReview.selectionReason: Selected Wikidata because its population statement includes the reviewed city entity and a point-in-time qualifier; GeoNames is retained as a magnitude check, not averaged.
